note: Training camp and preseason status for fantasy-relevant skill positions. Written as reporting, not as notes. `timeline` uses a fixed vocabulary — 'Out for 2026 season', 'Week to week', 'Day to day', a stated duration, or a named target week — and always carries an `attribution`, because this site reports what a team, coach or physician has said and never estimates a return itself (§5.3). `latest` is a complete declarative sentence describing what has happened, not a comment on it. A blank timeline means none has been stated, not that the injury is minor.

data.name: Jordyn Tyson
data.latest: HC Kellen Moore confirmed the hamstring injury on Aug 14, and said the team is still gathering information on the recovery timeline.
data.history: Sustained a hamstring injury at rookie camp and rehabbed through minicamp. Strained the right hamstring in his final college season and reaggravated it in pre-draft training. Also tore the ACL, MCL and PCL in 2022 and broke a collarbone in 2024.

data.name: Ladd McConkey

data.name: George Kittle
data.timeline: Minimum four weeks if he opens the season on PUP
